A 4-year-old dog survived more than 50 hours alone in the snowy Alaska wilderness after an avalanche separated her from her owner. LouLou, a beloved huskydoodle, disappeared during a hike near Eklutna Lake after an avalanche injured two hikers, including her owner. Both men were rescued and hospitalized, but LouLou was nowhere to be found. After days of searching, two rescuers followed a new AirTag signal by helicopter, hiked 20 minutes through the snow, and finally heard the sound they had been hoping for: LouLou barking back. The remarkable rescue brings an emotional end to a frightening ordeal.

videos.caption:
I met another emaciated dog, are we shocked? I know I’m not, everyday there’s a new dog barely hanging on by a thread. Yet people still support backyard breeders and puppy mills, doesn’t this just break your heart? I can’t wrap my mind around it and I’m done trying to. So anyway, meet Alfie. I’m seriously jealous of the lucky person who gets to adopt and come home to him everyday, he’s such a sweetheart. I don’t believe Alfie is a true stray because we live in a big city and we have a lot of street feeders. Our strays out here typically are thicker with some rough skin from fleas etc. but completely emaciated means to me someone was keeping him like this. He has what appears to be maybe a sore on his butt from sitting in urine or feces. He needs someone who is familiar with a feeding diet and who can help get him on the road to being a healthy boy. I pray someone gives him a chance.  •Questions? Check the FAQ on my Instagram highlights  •ID: A210164 •Intake: stray  •male •3YR •28lbs (should weigh more, way too skinny) •Heartworm positive (not surprised, heartworms are treatable and not a death sentence, they are not contagious)  •good with cats? not sure •🚑𝗠𝗲𝗱𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗡𝗼𝘁𝗲𝘀: S/O: underweight, areas of alopecia/hair thinning, low HW+

We honestly had no intention on taking in another dog for quite some time. We are at max physical, financial, and emotional capacity... BUT we could not let this mother dog and her unborn puppies be euthanized tonight. This mother struggled to deliver four hours without help at human hands, we cannot let her down again. Please welcome Sundae to Sky Sanctuary. She is currently in surgery receiving an emergency C-section- this procedure is estimated to cost $4932.41. 1 am so hopeful that this community might surround Sunday with so much support- truly every dollar counts and is so very appreciated.
